rowText: The pinned test sentences stop showing after the first question. Found 2026-09-18. After the first question sent from a pinned sentence, the chip switched to the plugin's own everyday suggestions and nothing brought the pinned ones back for the rest of the sitting. It blocked MEGAERA-01, KB-FOLLOWUP-01 and KB-KILLSWITCH-01's Show details half.

pinnedList: how do i beat the gonarch in black mesa
black mesa how do i get across the electrified water
setup.note: The maintainer's own pinned list, already on the Deck. Nothing about it was edited for this check.

steps.action: Four questions had already been sent this sitting by other means
steps.chipAfter: still showing a pinned sentence, marked TEST

steps.action: Walk to the chip and press A
steps.result: the chip put its sentence into the question box. It does not send by itself.

steps.action: Down twice to the ask button, press A
steps.result: the question was sent; the box cleared

steps.action: Wait for the answer, then read the chip
steps.result: PASS -- the chip was still showing a pinned sentence, marked TEST, not one of the plugin's everyday suggestions
PASS -- it rotated to a DIFFERENT pinned sentence. So the rotation is still reading the pinned list, not just holding one leftover.

verdict: DOES NOT REPRODUCE on this build.
verdictSentence: A question was sent from a pinned chip -- the bug's exact trigger -- and afterwards the chip still offered pinned sentences and still cycled through the pinned list.
whatChangedTonight: The settings lane fixed the plugin writing its whole in-memory copy of the settings back to disk after any small change, which could undo an edit made to the file directly. That was the likely cause recorded on 2026-09-19. The automatic save now sends only what actually changed.
honestLimits: One sitting, one trigger. The original report says the chip failed for the REST of the sitting; this check covers one question and about half a minute afterwards, not a long session.
It is not proven that the settings fix is what cured it. What is proven is that the symptom is gone on a build that carries that fix.
The pinned list on the Deck was already correct when this check started, so the part of the original report about needing several reloads to get a wanted sentence to show first was not exercised.
whatThisUnblocks: The three checks recorded as blocked by this -- MEGAERA-01, KB-FOLLOWUP-01, and KB-KILLSWITCH-01's Show details half. Note that they are also unblocked by the separate finding that a question can be sent without the pinned chips at all (docs/test-evidence/plan63-ASK-WITHOUT-PINNED-CHIPS.json).
